Definition: from G2223; to bind about (especially with a belt):--gird.
BiblicalUsage: Zonnymi means to gird oneself, to fasten on the belt and get ready. The angel tells Peter in prison, 'Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals,' and Jesus tells Peter that when he is old another will gird him and carry him where he does not want to go. Girding is getting ready — for escape, or for death.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God girds His servants for whatever comes next, whether it is walking out of a prison or walking toward a cross.
